title: Load Tender Exception Report
subtitle: Load Tender: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Load Tender Exception Report covers offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance. The transport planning coordinator records Load Tender chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Load Tender Exception Report keeps Load Tender exceptions visible until the transport planning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Load Tender Exception Report at origin, destination, route, pickup window, delivery window, and equipment location. Document offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance identity before Load Tender begins. Compare offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance findings with stated Load Tender criteria; route unresolved Load Tender issues to authorized carrier-management reviewer. For Load Tender Exception Report, confirm requirements for Load Tender. Ask authorized carrier-management reviewer to review Load Tender conditions beyond the transport planning coordinator's role.

sections.guidance: Record when the issue was discovered, who reported it, the exact affected subject, and the initial condition.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when carrier, capacity, equipment, commitment, rate, or instruction authorization remains unresolved. Protect offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance; document the Load Tender notification and await authorized carrier-management reviewer direction.

blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance; mark only Load Tender evidence present in that record.

blocks.guidance: Record what was checked without converting an allegation, inference, or unavailable fact into an observation.

blocks.guidance: For Load Tender, identify affected offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance scope; ask transport planning coordinator to document the Load Tender immediate control before continuing.

sections.title: Corrective action, disposition, and review
sections.guidance: Track containment through disposition and an effectiveness check; do not close an incident merely because the immediate event stopped.
